title: Grading sandbox binds whole toolchain roots under HOME, not only PATH bin directories
body:
The grading sandbox (evals/units/sandbox.ts homeToolchains) hides HOME and binds back only the mise data/config directories and PATH entries under HOME. On hosts with nvm, cargo/rustup or pyenv layouts the libraries live beside `bin` (~/.nvm/versions/node/X/lib, ~/.rustup/toolchains), so a PATH-only bind breaks those toolchains inside the sandbox.
Acceptance: a toolchain root (the parent of a PATH `bin` entry, plus ~/.rustup when ~/.cargo/bin is on PATH) is bound read-only, still without credential files; test with a fake HOME holding an nvm-style layout.
Proof: node --test test/evals/screening-units.test.ts exits 0 with an nvm-layout toolchain test
